home.heroTitle: Free training, community and support for migrant workers in Singapore
home.heroBody: 24Asia is a migrant-led volunteer group. We believe empowerment, community collaboration, career growth and mental wellbeing create positive change in our societies.

learn.title: Free training programs
learn.intro: Practical, employer-relevant skills — always free for migrant workers.
learn.noCohorts: No open batches right now. Check back soon or register your interest.
learn.verifyIntro: Employers can confirm a 24Asia certificate is genuine. Enter the verification code printed on the certificate.

events.title: Events & community activities
events.intro: Join blood donation drives, beach cleanups, sports, cultural celebrations and live shows.

volunteerPublic.title: Volunteer opportunities
volunteerPublic.intro: Find a meaningful role, grow your skills and support your community.

support.title: Get support
support.intro: Reviewed wellbeing and career resources, and trusted local services.
support.urgentBody: 24Asia is not an emergency service. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact the services below right away.
